title: Natural written English (untested examples)
lesson: Opening: “I saw that the totals need to match the PDF, not just the old workbook.” Approach: “I’ll keep the original values and flag the rows that don’t line up.” Sample: “I can show you what that looks like on five rows first.” Closing: “Which column should I use to match the two files?” Negotiation: “That price covers the files you listed and one revision. If there are more scans, I’ll quote those separately.” Use contractions where natural, vary sentence length and cut filler. A few small human slips are acceptable — e.g. an occasional comma/period mix-up — as long as they don’t change the meaning; never fabricate credentials or fluency claims.
